language.title: Language
language.helperText: Choose the interface language. System follows your OS locale.
language.restartHint: Tray menu and notifications update immediately. Open break windows will use the new language on the next break.

smartBreaks.title: Smart Breaks
smartBreaks.helperText: Automatically detect natural breaks and reset the break timer.
smartBreaks.showNotification: Show notification when break automatically detected

snooze.title: Snooze
snooze.helperText: Snoozing allows you to postpone breaks when busy.

skip.title: Skip
skip.helperText: Allow skipping breaks entirely without rescheduling them.

workingHours.title: Working Hours
workingHours.helperText: Only show breaks during your configured work schedule.

backdrop.title: Backdrop
backdrop.helperText: Show a colored overlay behind break windows to limit distractions.

startup.title: Start at login
startup.helperText: Automatically start BreakTimer when you log into your computer.

tray.title: Menu Bar Text
tray.helperText: Show timing information next to the menu bar icon.

welcome.title: BreakTimer runs in the background
welcome.description: The app can be accessed via your system tray.

tray.nextBreakInLessThanMinute: Next break in less than a minute
